question: How many seats of Rajya Sabha are present in the state of Maharashtra?
solution:
The correct answer is __**19.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Rajya Sabha (which means the "Council of States") is the top house of the Parliament of India. Maharashtra elects **19 seats **and they're indirectly elected by using the kingdom legislators of Maharashtra.
 
• **The Rajya Sabha or Council of States is the upper house of the Parliament of India.**
 
 
• Membership is limited to** 250 participants,** and the existing Rajya Sabha has **245 individuals.**
 
 
 
• The participants of the **14th Maharashtra assembly of Maharashtra were elected inside the 2019 Maharashtra Legislative assembly election, **with outcomes introduced on 21 October 2019.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Rajya Sabha is the higher residence of the Parliament of India.
 
• Gujarat elects** eleven seats** and they are not directly elected by the kingdom legislators of Gujarat.
 
• There are** eighty parliamentary constituencies and 403 legislative meeting constituencies in Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• The capability seating ability of the Rajya Sabha is **250 (238 elected, 12 appointed)**, in step with article 80 of the Indian charter.
